Enum Class GameEvent.Type

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Enum<GameEvent.Type>
it.polimi.ingsw.model.game.GameEvent.Type
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, Comparable<GameEvent.Type>, Constable
Enclosing class:
GameEvent
public static enum GameEvent.Type extends Enum<GameEvent.Type>
Enumeration of the semantic types of events that can be broadcasted. Each event knows independently whether it represents a state-altering action that requires saving the game to disk.
